blocks.x: Where did they have those quadrilles, in the other halls, like at Conor Manion?

No, the most they had the quadrilles, was at the Masonic Hall, you see? You see, first part of the night at Masonic Hall, was supposed to be dick to dance, as they played, nothing more was, but after 12 o'clock, then the blues and quadrilles, and stuff, that slow-dried, the blues, that was hunky-tonk, see? They'd seen it in all, when we'd come in, they'd finish their work, they'd come in, and then that was rough, that's for the time, I want to be in there.
But the quadrilles, were in the, after midnight too?
12 o'clock playing quadrilles. 12 o'clock, first figure, yeah. 11.30, 11.30, first figure. Yeah, first figure, yeah. 11.30, first figure, first figure, And they all rest there.

See, now you wait till they all light up on the floor. All right, them guys get up on those old big foots, get up there and call figures. Ladies fast. Bob Foots. Yeah, just to the right, promenaded, man. Cut the wing and you...
Well, the same people that liked the blues liked the quadrilles.
